name: Odin
label: Corvo
description: A RAVEN ATTACK to the RIGHT. Odin holds his spear steady and extends his free arm as a command. The black raven visibly TAKES OFF from his shoulder, opens both wings, flies forward horizontally toward the right edge with several distinct wingbeats and a pecking dive, then circles back and lands on the shoulder. Odin stays in profile; this is a bird flight attack, not a spear strike. STRICT side-scroller view facing RIGHT for every frame, never turn toward camera. Clear anticipation, strong action and recovery. Preserve identity and crisp bone-silver charcoal pixel art, no new colors. Keep full sprite and moving weapons inside 256x192, same planted baseline, same scale. Static camera. Transparent. Stay in place; no camera pan.
